scripts.start: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run generate:api && ng serve
scripts.test: pnpm run test:unit && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.test:browser: ng test --watch=false --coverage --coverage-reporters=cobertura --coverage-reporters=html --reporters=junit --output-file=target/test-results/browser.xml --browsers chromium --headless --include src/app/api/system-information.api.spec.ts --include src/app/api/target-storage.api.spec.ts --include src/app/app.spec.ts --include src/app/pages/target-storages.page.spec.ts --include 'src/app/shared/**/*.spec.ts' --include src/app/unexpected-failure.spec.ts
scripts.verify: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run generate:api && pnpm run verify:generated
scripts.verify:generated: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && ng build --configuration production
scripts.build: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run generate:api && ng build --configuration production
scripts.build:maven: pnpm run preflight && pnpm run generate:api:maven && ng build --configuration maven
